crossRefs.note: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.
But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years…

translations.web: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: then the priest shall calculate for him the value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the man shall pay the assessed value on that day as a sacred offering to the LORD.
translations.kjv: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD.
translations.asv: then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation unto the year of jubilee: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto Jehovah.
